leads.title: Vriend v Alberta - Supreme Court of Canada (1998)
leads.documents: Found Alberta legislature's failure to include sexual orientation as prohibited ground in provincial human rights law was itself a violation of Section 15 Charter rights; foundation for later explicit protection of sexual orientation and gender identity.
leads.detail: Cited as 'its 1998 decision in Vriend v Alberta' under Constitutional framework / Legal and equality rights; no URL visible in excerpt

leads.title: Alberta Marriage Act amendment (2000)
leads.documents: Amended Alberta Marriage Act to define marriage as between a man and a woman and invoked Charter s.33 notwithstanding clause; described as invalid because capacity to marry is exclusive federal jurisdiction; 5-year exemption expired 2005.
leads.detail: Cited as 'In 2000, Alberta amended its Marriage Act to define marriage as being between a man and a woman. The law invoked the notwithstanding clause'; no URL visible

leads.title: Health Statutes Amendment Act, 2024 (Alberta)
leads.documents: One of three 2024 Alberta laws affecting trans health care / youth; met with legal challenges in Alberta courts; relevant to transgender legal status and health access in Alberta.
leads.detail: Listed verbatim as 'Health Statutes Amendment Act, 2024' in Notwithstanding clause section; no URL visible

leads.title: Education Amendment Act, 2024 (Alberta)
leads.documents: One of three 2024 Alberta laws affecting LGBTQ / trans students in education; challenged in Alberta courts; relevant to school environment and rights machinery.
leads.detail: Listed verbatim as 'Education Amendment Act, 2024' in Notwithstanding clause section; no URL visible

leads.title: Fairness and Safety in Sport Act (Alberta, 2024)
leads.documents: One of three 2024 Alberta laws restricting trans participation, part of package affecting trans rights in sport; challenged in Alberta courts.
leads.detail: Listed verbatim as 'Fairness and Safety in Sport Act' in Notwithstanding clause section; no URL visible

leads.title: Bill 9: Protecting Alberta's Children Statutes Amendment Act, 2025
leads.documents: Alberta law that invoked the notwithstanding clause to prevent Charter challenges to the three 2024 Acts above; documents use of override to shield anti-trans measures from judicial review.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Bill 9: Protecting Alberta's Children Statutes Amendment Act, 2025, which used the notwithstanding clause'; no URL visible

leads.title: Alberta court declaration on Criminal Code s.159 unconstitutional
leads.documents: Alberta court among courts in Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Nova Scotia, and Alberta that independently declared s.159 (anal intercourse offence) unconstitutional as violation of Charter equality provision.
leads.detail: Text: 'courts in Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Nova Scotia, and Alberta each independently declared section 159 to be unconstitutional'; no case name or URL visible

leads.title: Alberta adoption law - stepchild adoption (1999) and joint adoption (2007)
leads.documents: Documents timeline of same-sex parental rights in Alberta: stepchild adoption legalized 1999, joint adoption legalized 2007.
leads.detail: Text: 'In Alberta, stepchild adoption was legalized in 1999. Eight years later, in 2007, joint adoption became legal in Alberta.'; no URL visible

leads.title: Non-recognition of same-sex marriage in Alberta until July 2005
leads.documents: Documents that by July 2005 same-sex marriages were legally recognized everywhere except Alberta, Prince Edward Island, Northwest Territories and Nunavut, covering 85% of population; shows Alberta as holdout jurisdiction.
leads.detail: Text: 'By July 2005, same-sex marriages were legally recognized in all provinces and territories except Alberta, Prince Edward Island, the Northwest Territories and Nunavut'; no URL visible
